de.vaultGuideContent:
📊 What Do These Numbers Mean?

• Vault Balance (Wallet): The cumulative net balance of the vault of all-time. It is the sum of the initial vault balance and all transactions recorded since inception.

• Income (This Month): The total estimated income for the current calendar month.

• Expense (This Month): The total estimated expense for the current calendar month.

💡 Important Note:
Since the main balance is cumulative (all-time), it is normal for it to differ from the net difference of this month's income and expense.

it.vaultGuideContent:
📊 What Do These Numbers Mean?

• Vault Balance (Wallet): The cumulative net balance of the vault of all-time. It is the sum of the initial vault balance and all transactions recorded since inception.

• Income (This Month): The total estimated income for the current calendar month.

• Expense (This Month): The total estimated expense for the current calendar month.

💡 Important Note:
Since the main balance is cumulative (all-time), it is normal for it to differ from the net difference of this month's income and expense.

pt.vaultGuideContent:
📊 What Do These Numbers Mean?

• Vault Balance (Wallet): The cumulative net balance of the vault of all-time. It is the sum of the initial vault balance and all transactions recorded since inception.

• Income (This Month): The total estimated income for the current calendar month.

• Expense (This Month): The total estimated expense for the current calendar month.

💡 Important Note:
Since the main balance is cumulative (all-time), it is normal for it to differ from the net difference of this month's income and expense.
